summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. (CPAC), a Peruvian cement producer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that Holcim Ltd., which indirectly acquired a controlling stake, requested an extension from Peru's SMV to commence a mandatory tender offer (OPA) for CPAC's common shares. Holcim seeks up to 60 business days from the appointment of a valuation entity to launch the offer, which would cover up to 100% of shares not owned by Holcim's subsidiary Inversiones ASPI S.A. The filing provides no price, premium, or valuation details. The extension request indicates a delayed timeline for the mandatory takeover bid, with the regulatory clock pending SMV approval.
